questions: How do I open a store
How can I start a store
How do I become a seller
Where do I create my store
I want to start selling
How can I set up a shop
answer: Create an account and use the store-creation flow. It covers Store Basics, Branding, Payments, and Review & Launch. Add at least one product before launch. Open the store setup from /signup.

questions: What are the store setup steps
What happens when I open a store
What does store onboarding include
Which steps are in store setup
How does seller onboarding work
What do I do during store setup
answer: Store setup has {{ONBOARDING_STEP_COUNT}} steps: {{ONBOARDING_STEPS}}. A store needs at least one product before it can launch.

questions: Do I need a product before launching
Can I launch a store with no products
Why can’t I launch my store
How many products do I need to launch
What must I add before launch
Why is the product form required
answer: A store needs at least one product before it can launch. If the store has no products at the final step, NextaStore sends you to the product form.

questions: Is NextaStore free for buyers
Do buyers pay a platform fee
Is buying free
Does NextaStore charge buyers
Do I pay to browse products
Is there a buyer subscription
answer: Browsing and buying has no platform fee charged to the buyer through the app itself. Selling uses the Seller Pass subscription.

questions: What is Seller Pass
How does Seller Pass work
What is the seller subscription
Why do I need Seller Pass
What keeps my store active
Tell me about the Seller Pass
answer: Seller Pass keeps a store active on NextaStore. Every new store starts with a free trial of {{SUBSCRIPTION_TRIAL_DAYS}} days. Paid coverage is bought in month-blocks.

questions: How much is Seller Pass
What does Seller Pass cost
What is the Seller Pass price
How much do I pay for a store
What is the monthly seller fee
Tell me the subscription price
answer: Seller Pass costs UGX {{SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_UGX}} per month of coverage. The current generated platform facts are the authority for this price.

questions: How long is the free trial
How many trial days do new stores get
Do new stores get a free trial
Is there a Seller Pass trial
When does the seller trial end
How long can I try selling before paying
answer: Every new store starts with a free trial of {{SUBSCRIPTION_TRIAL_DAYS}} days.

questions: How many months can I buy
What coverage periods are available
Which Seller Pass blocks can I purchase
Can I pay for several months
What subscription month options exist
How do Seller Pass blocks work
answer: Seller Pass coverage is bought in blocks of {{SUBSCRIPTION_BLOCK_MONTHS}} months. The amount entered on the subscription page must match the monthly price multiplied by the selected months.

questions: How is the Seller Pass amount calculated
How do I calculate a coverage block
What would a multi month block cost
How does subscription pricing multiply
How is the amount for several months worked out
How do I work out my Seller Pass payment
answer: The amount for a coverage block is the monthly price multiplied by the number of months. For example, {{SUBSCRIPTION_EXAMPLE_MONTHS}} months is UGX {{SUBSCRIPTION_EXAMPLE_PRICE_UGX}}.

questions: How do I pay for Seller Pass
How do I submit a subscription payment
Where do I enter my payment reference
What happens after I pay Seller Pass
How do subscription payments get approved
How do I renew Seller Pass
answer: Pick a coverage block, send the mobile-money payment to the code or number shown, then submit the payment reference on the subscription page. An admin reviews and approves it before the paid coverage is extended.

questions: What does a subscription payment awaiting review mean
Why has my Seller Pass payment not been approved
How are subscription payments reviewed
When does a Seller Pass payment count as paid
Why is my subscription payment waiting
What happens to an unapproved Seller Pass payment
answer: Seller Pass payments stay awaiting review until an admin checks the submitted reference. They are treated as approved when accepted or not confirmed when rejected. There is no fixed approval time in the knowledge base.

questions: What happens when Seller Pass expires
What if my store coverage lapses
What happens after my trial ends without renewal
Will my store stay active after coverage ends
What happens when my subscription runs out
How do I avoid a coverage lapse
answer: If paid coverage or the trial runs out before renewal, the subscription status shows as ended and the seller is prompted to renew. Renewing before then keeps the store active without interruption.

questions: How do seller badges work
How do I get a seller badge
What badges can sellers earn
How do I become a verified seller
How do the trust badges work
What gives a store a badge
answer: Seller badges come from continuous paid Seller Pass coverage. Verified Seller starts at {{BADGE_VERIFIED_SELLER_MONTHS}} or more months, Gold Partner at {{BADGE_GOLD_PARTNER_MONTHS}} or more, and Platinum Partner at {{BADGE_PLATINUM_PARTNER_MONTHS}} or more. A lapse starts the count again.

questions: When does a seller badge appear
When is my badge applied
Why is my seller badge missing
How long before my badge shows
Does an approved payment trigger a badge
When does the trust badge update
answer: The badge is applied when an admin approves the payment that takes the store to the required tier, and it shows only while the store stays paid up.

questions: What payment methods are available
How can buyers pay
Which payment options does NextaStore support
Can I pay by mobile money
Does NextaStore accept card payments
How do payment methods work
answer: Payment methods are dynamic. Platform admins enable methods, and each store chooses which enabled methods it accepts. At checkout you see the overlap for that store. The platform currently includes MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, and card as payment options stores can opt into.

questions: Can I pay with MTN MoMo
Does NextaStore support Airtel Money
Can I use mobile money
How does mobile money payment work
Are MTN and Airtel supported
Which mobile money services are built in
answer: The platform includes MTN MoMo and Airtel Money. A store that accepts one or both shows the relevant phone number or merchant code at checkout.

questions: Can I pay by card
Does NextaStore accept cards
Why is card missing at checkout
How does card payment work
Can a store enable card payments
Is card an option for buyers
answer: Card is a payment option a store can opt into. If it is not shown for a particular store, that store has not enabled it.

questions: Why is my payment method missing
Why can’t I see mobile money at checkout
Why is card not showing
Why can’t I find a payment option
The checkout does not show my payment method
What if a store does not accept my payment method
answer: A payment method must be enabled platform-wide and accepted by that specific store to appear at checkout. Ask the seller through Messages or use another accepted method.

questions: My payment failed
What should I do if payment is stuck
A payment did not go through
Why did my payment fail
How do I report a payment problem
I was charged but checkout failed
answer: For a genuine payment failure, do not guess at a fix. Contact NextaStore support with the order or payment reference so a human can check the transaction record.

questions: How do I find products
Where can I browse products
How do I search the marketplace
Can I filter products
How do I find a product on NextaStore
Where do I shop
answer: Browse the Marketplace page, search, and filter by category. Each store also has its own store page with that seller’s products.

questions: What is on a product page
What information does a product show
Can I see stock before buying
Where do I favorite a product
Can I message a seller before buying
What can I do from product details
answer: A product detail page shows price, description, images, sold count, and stock status. You can add the item to your cart, favorite it, follow the store, or message the seller.

questions: How does checkout work
What happens when I check out
How do I place an order
What do I choose at checkout
How do I finish a purchase
What happens after adding to cart
answer: At checkout you choose the delivery district or address and a payment method. Only methods enabled by the platform and accepted by that store are shown.

questions: Where can I track my order
How do I see my order
Where are my orders
How do order updates work
Can I track an order on NextaStore
Where do I see order status
answer: After checkout, the order appears on the buyer’s Orders page. Its status updates as the seller processes it, and notifications can be sent when the status changes.

questions: What order states are there
How many order stages exist
What are the order status labels
How do I understand order progress
What does my order stage mean
Which order stages does NextaStore use
answer: The platform order statuses are {{ORDER_STATUSES}}. Buyers see friendlier labels: {{ORDER_LABEL_PENDING}}, {{ORDER_LABEL_PROCESSING}}, {{ORDER_LABEL_SHIPPED}}, {{ORDER_LABEL_DELIVERED}}, and {{ORDER_LABEL_CANCELLED}} for the corresponding internal statuses.

questions: How do sellers process orders
What can a seller do with an order
How does a seller move an order forward
Which order actions can sellers take
How do I confirm a seller order
How do I complete an order as a seller
answer: Sellers move orders from the dashboard: {{SELLER_ORDER_MOVES}}. Orders that are completed or already ended cannot be changed.

questions: Can I cancel an order
How do I cancel my order
Can a buyer cancel after checkout
Where do I cancel an order
I want to cancel a purchase
What are the buyer cancellation rules
answer: A buyer can cancel from the Orders page only while the order is {{BUYER_CANCEL_ALLOWED_STATUSES}}, and only within {{BUYER_CANCEL_WINDOW_MINUTES}} minutes of placing it. A short reason is required.

questions: How often can I cancel orders
Is there a cancellation limit
How many orders can I cancel
Why can’t I cancel another order
What is the buyer cancellation limit
When does the cancellation limit reset
answer: A buyer can use the self-cancellation option at most {{BUYER_CANCEL_LIMIT}} orders in any {{BUYER_CANCEL_LIMIT_WINDOW_DAYS}} days. After the window or limit, message the seller.

questions: Can a seller cancel an order
When can a seller cancel
Can sellers cancel orders that are still being handled
Can a seller cancel when stock is missing
What if the seller cannot fulfil my order
How does seller cancellation work
answer: A seller can cancel an order while it is still awaiting seller action or being processed, for example when an item is out of stock.

questions: Does NextaStore support delivery
Can I pick up an order
What is delivery versus pickup
How do I choose delivery
Can a store offer pickup
Do I need an address for delivery
answer: At checkout, store items are fulfilled by {{FULFILLMENT_METHODS}}. Delivery needs a delivery address; pickup does not.

questions: What can I sell on NextaStore
What types of listings are allowed
Can I sell a service
Can I sell a digital item
Are only physical products supported
What listing types exist
answer: A listing can be {{LISTING_TYPES}}. Physical listings use the cart and stock; service and digital listings use Messages for shopper enquiries.

questions: How do I contact a seller
Can I message a seller before buying
Where do I ask a seller a question
How do buyers contact stores
How do I ask about a product
Can I message about an order
answer: Use Messages to contact the seller. Buyers and sellers can message about a product before buying, an order after buying, or general questions.

questions: How do I buy safely
What are the safety rules
How can I avoid scams
Is it safe to pay outside the platform
What should I do if a seller pressures me
How do I stay safe on NextaStore
answer: Keep payment and communication on the platform where there is a record. Be cautious if someone pushes you to move payment or communication off-platform before the order has been sent or confirmed.

questions: Should I share my password with support
Can I give Nexi my OTP
Should I share my payment PIN
Does support need my password
Can I send card details in chat
What sensitive information should I keep private
answer: Never share passwords, one-time login codes, payment PINs, or full card numbers in chat. Nexi does not need them.

questions: How do I report a suspicious user
Where do I report a scam
How do I report a problem
What should I do about a suspicious seller
How do I report an unsafe transaction
Where can I report fraud
answer: Use the Safety page and/or Messages to report a specific user or order. For platform-level action or suspected fraud, contact NextaStore support.

questions: What if my order is wrong
What if an item is damaged
What if my order is missing
The seller is not responding
What do I do about an order problem
How do I resolve a bad order
answer: Start with Messages and try to resolve the issue directly with the seller. If it is not resolved or involves money or safety, escalate to support with the order number.

questions: I forgot my password
How do I reset my password
Where can I change a forgotten password
I cannot log in
What if I lost my password
How do I recover my account
answer: Use the forgot-password flow on the login page. If you suspect the account is compromised, change the password and, where available, log out of other devices.

questions: How do I create an account
Where do I sign up
How do I register
Can I create a NextaStore account
How do I join NextaStore
Where is the signup page
answer: Use /signup to create an account. If you want to sell, continue into the store-creation flow from there.

questions: Does NextaStore have an app
Can I install NextaStore on my phone
Is NextaStore a mobile app
Can I add NextaStore to my home screen
Does NextaStore support push notifications
Can I install the site
answer: NextaStore is an installable Progressive Web App. You can add it to a phone’s home screen from the browser, and push notifications are supported when enabled.

questions: What notifications do I get
How do order notifications work
Will I get seller notifications
Do followers get new product alerts
Can I receive push notifications
What can NextaStore notify me about
answer: In-app notifications cover order status changes, new messages, new products from followed stores, and seller subscription reminders. Push notifications mirror important ones when enabled.

questions: What are favorites and following
How do I save a product
What does following a store do
Do followers get product alerts
Where are my favorite products
What is the difference between favorite and follow
answer: Favorites save individual products for later. Following subscribes you to a store, and followers are notified when that store adds a new product.

questions: How can I customize my store
Can I add a logo and banner
Can I change my store theme
Can I add store SEO details
How do I set my store location
What can sellers customize
answer: From the seller dashboard you can set a logo and banner, store theme and product-grid layout, district/address and directions, plus SEO title, description, and keywords.

questions: How do I add products
What product fields can I edit
Can I add product images
How do I manage stock
Can I show a discount price
Where do sellers manage products
answer: Sellers manage products from the dashboard product form. It supports name, description, price, original or strikethrough price, category, and images; sold counts and stock are tracked.

questions: How do I know where a store delivers
Where do I find a store location
Does NextaStore have one delivery area
Can every store choose its location
Where are store delivery details
How do I check a seller’s area
answer: Stores set their own district, address, and delivery details. Check the specific store page for its location and delivery information.

questions: What should I do before launching
How can I make my new store trustworthy
What should my first listings look like
How do I prepare a new store
What should I sell first
How can I get started selling
answer: Use clear photos, honest prices, short descriptions, and a small focused range of listings. Share your store link, reply to messages promptly, and make sure you can restock and fulfil what you list.
